# tests/fixtures/chat_about_perf.txt
# A 10-turn fixture conversation: user is troubleshooting a slow
# /metrics endpoint and eventually asks the listener to file an issue.
# Format: alternating "user:" / "assistant:" lines. The listener under
# test reads roughly the last 10 turns and drafts an issue body when
# the trigger phrase fires.

user: Our /metrics endpoint is taking 14 seconds to respond in production.
assistant: That is much slower than the SLO. Have you looked at flame graphs from the last hour?
user: Yes — most of the time is spent in PrometheusRegistry.collect across thirty registries.
assistant: That is a known issue when histogram buckets are set per-route. How many routes do you have?
user: Around 800 routes, each with a per-method histogram.
assistant: 800 routes × 6 methods × 12 buckets is ~57k samples per scrape — that explains the latency.
user: Can we collapse the per-route histograms into a single global histogram?
assistant: Yes, drop the per-route label and keep status/method as labels. That cuts cardinality by ~800x.
user: Will that lose the per-route p99?
assistant: You will lose per-route p99 from /metrics, but you can keep it inside in-memory dashboards or sample it at trace level.
user: Okay. I would like to file an issue to track this work — owner is the platform team.
assistant: Okay. Drafting an issue body. Ready to confirm.
